name: Victoria
subtitle: Victoria, capital of Seychelles: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 29,664 people live in the Victoria agglomeration (counted 2022).
The town on Mahe that became Victoria was founded by the French in 1778; the island had been claimed by France in 1756.
Seychelles' first settlement dates to 1770 (the French-led party). Note: Kreol dates Victoria itself to 1778; the 1770 settlement is of the islands, not verified as Victoria's site.

parts.text: The town on Mahe that became Victoria was founded by the French in 1778; the island had been claimed by France in 1756.
Seychelles' first settlement dates to 1770 (the French-led party). Note: Kreol dates Victoria itself to 1778; the 1770 settlement is of the islands, not verified as Victoria's site.
The capital was named Victoria in 1841, during the administration of Mylius.
The settlement was long known locally as L'Etablissement.
Seychelles was under British rule 1811-1976 and became independent as a republic on 29 June 1976.

blocks.prompt: About how many people do you think live in the Victoria agglomeration?

parts.text: 29,664 in 2022, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Victoria, listed as an agglomeration (status 'Aggl') in Mahe, at the census of 1 July 2022; citypopulation.de attributes the 2022 figure to the National Statistics Bureau, Seychelles.

items.text: French found the settlement on Mahe that became Victoria.
Seychelles ceded to Britain under the Treaty of Paris.
Victoria Clock Tower inaugurated by Governor Sweet-Escott.
National museum established, starting in the Carnegie building.
Independence from Britain; Seychelles becomes a republic.
